## Efficient execution guidance

- Planning, Work, and Review now route long-running commands to shared guidance for completion-aware
  waiting, process ownership, interruption recovery, compact output, and justified retries.
- Full permitted diagnostic evidence stays in existing artifacts. The approximate 1,000-token
  routine output target never suppresses failures or replaces the complete finding inventory.
- Execution details fit within the existing proof budget. Provider-helper examples now request its
  supported 60-second wait, subject to host limits and intervention needs.

This backward-compatible patch changes packaged guidance. Runtime execution, required checks,
configuration, and failure handling remain unchanged. Adopters receive the guidance when their
runtime lock is updated to this release. Agent compliance and token savings are not established
by publication; no adopter update or host-level enforcement is included.
